def build_arcs(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        tail = []
        head = []
        capa = []
        cost = []
        slot_blk = []
        for s in range(S):
            a = self.abase + 3 * s
            blk = [len(tail)]
            tail.append(self.R)
            head.append(a)
            capa.append(self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s])
            cost.append(0)
            blk.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(a)
            head.append(a + 1)
            capa.append(self.B)
            cost.append(0)
            if s + 1 < S:
                blk.append(len(tail))
                tail.append(a + 1)
                head.append(a + 3)
                capa.append(self.B)
                cost.append(0)
            else:
                blk.append(-1)
            blk.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(a + 1)
            head.append(a + 2)
            capa.append(self.qcap[s])
            cost.append(0)
            slot_blk.append(blk)
        dense_start = len(tail)
        times = self.times
        ready = self.ready
        value = self.value
        W = self.W
        wbase = self.wbase
        for s in range(S):
            e = self.abase + 3 * s + 2
            ts = times[s]
            for j in self.pslot[s]:
                tail.append(e)
                head.append(wbase + j)
                capa.append(1)
                cost.append((ts - ready[j]) - value[j] * W)
        dense_end = len(tail)
        win_arc = []
        for j in range(J):
            win_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(wbase + j)
            head.append(self.zbase + self.wflow[j])
            capa.append(1)
            cost.append(0)
        flow_arc = []
        for f in range(F):
            flow_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(self.zbase + f)
            head.append(self.fhead[f])
            capa.append(self.ceiling[f])
            cost.append(0)
        group_arc = []
        for g in range(G):
            group_arc.append(len(tail))
            tail.append(self.hbase + g)
            head.append(self.ghead[g])
            capa.append(self.gceil[g])
            cost.append(0)
        back = len(tail)
        tail.append(self.Z)
        head.append(self.R)
        capa.append(J)
        cost.append(0)
        self.slot_blk = slot_blk
        self.dense_start = dense_start
        self.dense_end = dense_end
        self.win_arc = win_arc
        self.flow_arc = flow_arc
        self.group_arc = group_arc
        self.back_arc = back
        self.tail = tail
        self.head = head
        self.capa = capa
        self.cost = cost
        self.narcs = len(tail)
        self.set_lowers([0] * F)

    def set_lowers(self, low):
        self.low = low
